Item.Description: A transparency slide showing the left side of a very worn carousel pig. The skin of the pig is light tan in some areas, but most of the skin is colored black, possibly where the paint has been removed. The saddle is brown and yellow. The saddle blanket is green with yellow flowers. The tack is red. The pig is standing on the ground with a white backdrop. There are numerous black spots on the image as well as a black strip running through the pigs head, possibly from a hair. The slide reads “PULLEN PARK CAROUSEL PULLEN PARK 16B LEFT” at the top and “RALEIGH NC WAKE CO JUN79A7 6-79 RR RALEIGH FINE ARTS SOCIETY” at the bottom.

Title: Pullen Park Carousel - PPC2019.001.526
